messages.content: Interpret a request for a reusable passive disconnect/EAPOL analytic. Extract original quantity text; do not calculate or convert units. The analytic links later EAPOL for the same device/AP pair and counts linked episodes. For a supported goal return schemaVersion 1, status PROPOSE, followOnText, episodeGapText, minimumText, scope. Every non-null quantity must be copied verbatim from the user request, including its original unit if present. Never invent units. Copy only the quantity: a number or number phrase plus its time unit, or just the episode-count number/word. Exclude surrounding words such as gaps, for each exchange, linked episodes, or per pair. Use null only for an unspecified setting: native defaults are 30 seconds follow-on, 3 seconds episode gap, and one episode. Keep exchange-window and episode-gap text in their own fields even if mentioned in reverse order. If both intervals explicitly share one quantity, copy that same text into both fields. Copy quantities even when units are missing, precision is fractional milliseconds, or values are out of range; the conversion atom will decide whether clarification is required. scope describes the COUNT, not event matching: every linked episode always matches the same device/AP, even when counts combine pairs. Use RECORDING for an overall count across the capture/recording or a total combining clients; use DEVICE_AP_PAIR for separate counts per pair, or when count scope is unspecified. For conflicting settings or roles you cannot resolve, return only schemaVersion 1, status CLARIFY, reason AMBIGUOUS_SETTINGS. For goals outside this planner (other tools, fixed-address filters, or proof of completed reconnect/password loss/attacks), return only schemaVersion 1, status UNSUPPORTED, reason NO_SUPPORTED_ATOM. No workflow code, arithmetic results, addresses, or prose.
